notes.title: Day 1 Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Hope you are all enjoying the game, in this update we addressed some of the issues players had on day 1.
Whats new?
- Rebalanced the bribe system
     If caught with a small bribe you will now loose 50 favor with the government opposed to 
     90 previously with big bribes you will now loose 75 favor
- New case generation system
     Case generation has been redone to reduce the amount of encounters with repeat cases we 
     are still working to improve this so there may be more updates regarding this in the future!
- Minor bug fixes

Upcoming updates:
Chinese language support & Russian language support (ETA: 1 week)
New animation system (ETA: 2 weeks)

We are also looking for help with translating for other languages if you would like to help please make a discussion post, thanks!

Thanks everyone! If you run into any more issues or have any suggestions please feel free to visit the community discussion page, (easiest place to get my attention).
